datasets.title: Floodwater depth in Camarines Sur Provinces & Albay Province, Bicol Region of Philippines as of 1 November 2020
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: TC20201101PHL This map illustrates floodwater depth in Nabua and Baao Municipalities, Camarines Sur Provinces & Bato and Libon, Albay Province, Bicol Region (Region V) of Philippines based on surface waters observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 1st of November 2020 and digital elevation model data with the floodwater depth estimation tool (FwDET). This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR-UNOSAT. Important Note: Flood analysis from radar images may underestimate the presence of standing waters in built-up areas and densely vegetated areas due to backscattering properties of the radar signal.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/floodwater-depth-in-camarines-sur-provinces-albay-province-bicol-region-of-philippines-as-]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: Sentinel-1 radar imagery acquired on 1 November 2020 was analyzed to detect surface water extent in the aftermath of typhoon-induced flooding. Floodwater depth was estimated by integrating the water extent with digital elevation model data using UNOSAT's FwDET algorithm. The resulting depth raster represents observed flood conditions at a single point in time without field validation.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar imagery and digital elevation model data processed to estimate floodwater depth using the Floodwater Depth Estimation Tool (FwDET)
